description: Hand-written replicas of OpenAI chat.completion replies in the formats gpt-4o-mini produces (structured JSON, fenced JSON, plain Markdown with various citation markers, refusals). They were NOT captured from the OpenAI API (no key was available); they reproduce the envelope fields and content styles so the parser and AnswerService can be tested against them. Each case is answered against 3 sources.

cases.name: structured_answered
cases.content: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Customers can return unused items **within 30 days of delivery** [1]. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days [2].", "citations": [1, 2], "missing_information": ""}

cases.name: structured_partial
cases.note: partial answer: supported part + what is missing
cases.content: {"status": "partial", "answer": "The policy allows returns within 30 days of delivery [1]. It does not say whether shipping costs are refunded.", "citations": [1], "missing_information": "Whether return shipping is refunded."}

cases.name: structured_insufficient
cases.content: {"status": "insufficient", "answer": "The provided sources do not mention warranty coverage.", "citations": [], "missing_information": "Warranty terms."}

cases.name: fenced_json
cases.note: JSON in a ```json fence (common without structured outputs)
cases.content:
```json
{
  "status": "answered",
  "answer": "Damaged items must be reported within 48 hours [3].",
  "citations": [3],
  "missing_information": ""
}
```

cases.name: prose_then_json
cases.note: short preface before the JSON object
cases.content:
Here is the answer based on the sources:
{"status": "answered", "answer": "Refunds are issued to the original payment method [2].", "citations": [2], "missing_information": ""}

cases.name: plain_numeric_markers
cases.content:
You have **30 days** from delivery to return an item [1].

- Report damage within 48 hours [1, 3].
- Refunds take 5-7 business days [2].

cases.name: legacy_s_markers
cases.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery [S1][S2].

cases.name: source_word_markers
cases.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days [Source 1]. Damage must be reported within 48 hours (Source 3).

cases.name: fullwidth_markers
cases.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery【1】.

cases.name: json_alternate_fields
cases.note: alternate field names and string citations

cases.name: forged_and_valid
cases.note: one valid citation survives, forged ones dropped
cases.content: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Returns within 30 days [1]. Lifetime refunds apply [7]. See also [12].", "citations": [1, 7, 12], "missing_information": ""}

cases.name: uncited_text
cases.content: Customers can return items within 30 days.

cases.name: sentinel_reply
cases.note: what the previous prompt asked for when evidence felt incomplete; matches the reported log (retrieved 5, llm_called true)

cases.name: sentinel_then_partial
cases.note: sentinel followed by a cited partial answer
cases.content: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: the sources only say returns are accepted within 30 days [1].

cases.name: refusal_null_content
cases.note: structured-output safety refusal: content null, refusal set
cases.refusal: I'm sorry, I can't help with that.

cases.name: year_in_brackets
cases.note: a bracketed year is text, not a citation
cases.content: The policy was last revised in [2024] and allows returns within 30 days [1].
